get.description: Call to get the JSON schema associated with the grid session used for row validation.

200.description: The JSON schema used to validate the rows of the grid session.

put.description: Submit a feature request to enhance Grid Agent capabilities for tabular data curation. Agents can specify the desired functionality, category, priority level, use case, and target user role.

Use this function to query grid data using structured filter objects. IMPORTANT: The 'filters' parameter requires JSON filter objects with specific 'concreteType' values - do not use SQL syntax. Use RowIsValidFilter for validation errors, CellValueFilter for column comparisons, RowSelectionFilter for user selections, and RowValidationResultFilter for specific error messages.

columnName.description: The name of the column.  Will be the alias if one is provide in the select item.

columnIndex.description: The index of this column. The first column will have an index of zero.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: Information about a single selected column.

concreteType.description: Required. Must match the full name of one of the four filter types: 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowValidationResultFilter' or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowSelectionFilter', or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter' or, 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter'

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: There are four different types of filters that can be applied to a grid query. For example, a filter to find all rows where column named: 'someInt' has a value greater than 12, the following filter would be used:{"concreteType":"org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter","columnName":"someInt","operator":"GREATER_THAN","value":[12]}. In order to find all rows with a JSON schema validation error use the following filter: {"concreteType":"org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter","value":false}.  In order to find all rows with JSON schema validation error message that indicates the wrong type was provided, you could use the filter: {"concreteType:"org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowValidationResultFilter","operator":"LIKE","validationResultValue":"%expected type%"}. In order to find all rows that are currently selected by the user, you would use the following filter: {"concreteType":"org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowSelectionFilter","isSelected":true}.

featureDescription.description: Detailed description of the requested function and how it would help with tabular data curation.

category.description: Category of the requested feature for better organization and prioritization.

priority.description: Suggested priority level for the feature request.

useCase.description: Specific use case or scenario where this feature would be beneficial.

userRole.description: Role or type of user who would benefit from this feature (e.g., data analyst, researcher, business user).

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.Agen.description: Request for a new function to enhance Agent capabilities for tabular data curation.

validationResultValue.description: A validation result value.  For wildcards use '%' to represents zero or more characters, and '_' to represents a single character.  For example, LIKE '%expected type: String, found%' would match rows with a validation result that contains the message: 'expected type: String, found'. Use the 'NOT_LIKE' operator to find all rows that do not have a validation message matching the provided 'validationResultValue'.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: Use this filter to find rows that have data quality issues or schema validation errors. This is ideal for requests about finding 'errors', 'invalid data', or 'rows that failed validation'. To find rows with a specific error message, set the 'operator' to 'LIKE' and provide the error text in 'validationResultValue'. For example, for a user request like 'show me all rows with a type error', a good value for 'validationResultValue' would be '%expected type:%'.

cellValues.description: An array of cell values for a single row.  Each cell's index will corresponds to the SelectColumn.columnIndex

validationResults.description: Results of a grid row against a JSON schema

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: A single row of a grid query result.

select.description: For cases where all columns should be returned then set 'select' to be 'ALL'.  For cases where the user would like a count of the number of rows then set 'select' to be 'COUNT'.

filters.description: Optional filters using structured JSON objects. Each filter must be a complete JSON object with the required 'concreteType' property. IMPORTANT: Do not use SQL syntax - use the predefined filter objects. Examples: To find invalid rows: [{"concreteType":"org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter","value":false}]. To find rows where 'age' > 25: [{"concreteType":"org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter","columnName":"age","operator":"GREATER_THAN","value":[25]}]. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic.

limit.description: Required. Limit of the number of rows returned to avoid loading more data than needed into your context window.

offset.description: Optional. specifies the offset of the first row to return.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: Defines a structured query using JSON filter objects - NOT SQL syntax. Use predefined filter types with specific concreteType values.

concreteType.description: Required. Must match the full name of one of the four filter types: 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowValidationResultFilter' or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowSelectionFilter', or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter' or, 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter'

value.description: Set to 'true' to find rows that are valid according to the schema. Set to 'false' to find rows that are invalid and have validation errors.'

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: Use this filter for simple requests to find all 'valid' or 'invalid' rows based on their overall validation status.

concreteType.description: Required. Must match the full name of one of the four filter types: 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowValidationResultFilter' or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowSelectionFilter', or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter' or, 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter'

isSelected.description: When true, only rows that the user has selected will be returned.  When false, rows that the user has selected with be excluded.  This filter should be excluded to ignore the user's row selection.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: Use this filter to narrow down results based on rows the user has actively selected in the interface. For user requests like 'show me only my selected items' or 'run this analysis on the rows I've checked', set the 'isSelected' property to true. For requests to see the opposite, like 'show me the unselected rows', set 'isSelected' to false. If the user makes no mention of selected items, do not include this filter in the query.

isValid.description: Will be 'true' if the row is valid according to the JSON schema. Will be 'false' when the row is invalid.

validationErrorMessage.description: If the object is not valid according to the schema, a simple one line error message will be provided.

allValidationMessages.description: If the object is not valid according to the schema, a the flat list of error messages will be provided with one error message per sub-schema.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: Results of a grid row against a JSON schema

allOf.description: Use allOf to 'extend' or 'implement' one or more schemas. See: allOf

definitions.description: In an effor to support draft-07 implementations, we are using 'definitions' instead of '$defs'. See: Appendix A

source.description: Used to indicate that this schema is derived from another object/schema.  The value should be a URL reference to the original work.  The 'source' is solely descriptive and should have no impact on validation.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.schema.Js.description: The JSON schema is defined by: json-schema.org, specifically draft-07. Only features listed here are currently supported.

concreteType.description: Required. Must match the full name of one of the four filter types: 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowValidationResultFilter' or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowSelectionFilter', or 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.RowIsValidFilter' or, 'org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.query.CellValueFilter'

columnName.description: Required. The name of the column to filter by.

value.description: A filter used to select rows based on a specific column's cell value. Use operators like 'EQUALS' or 'LIKE' with the 'value' array for standard comparisons. For user requests about finding 'empty', 'blank', or 'null' values, use the 'IS_NULL' operator and omit the 'value' property. To find rows that are not empty, use the 'IS_NOT_NULL' operator. When using either 'LIKE' or 'NOT_LIKE', the wildcard character: '%' is used to represents zero or more characters, and '_' is used to represents a single character.

org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.grid.quer.description: A filter used to select rows based on cell values. For example, to handle a user request like 'find all rows where the Project column is Alpha', you would set 'columnName' to 'Project', 'operator' to 'EQUALS', and 'value' to ['Alpha']
